limitations: The deposited MaxQuant search also contains six runs from 20220207 (FW/RV F1-F3) that are not in the PRIDE project, and splits each deposited file by FAIMS CV (-45/-65); only the four deposited RAW files are annotated.
Culture medium (SILAC EBM-2, Lonza, with EGM-2 BulletKit, 2% FCS) has no NCIT term and is given as 'not available'; the composition is recorded here.
The FAIMS compensation voltages (-45 and -65 V, alternating within each run) are not encoded as a column.
The RAW method's experiment names read 'TMT SPS-MS3' (template name); the acquisition is label-free-style MS2 (HCD, ion trap) as confirmed by msmsScans.txt.
sdrf-tools reconcile flags Trypsin as unsupported although the PRIDE protocol says 'digested overnight with trypsin' (false positive).

characteristics[cell line] = 'TIME' (Cellosaurus name) has no EFO/CLO/BTO term; the validator only accepts it because it coincides with EFO:0000721 'time'. CVCL_0047 in characteristics[cellosaurus accession] identifies the line.
Precursor tolerance 4.5 ppm is inferred from 'Default MaxQuant parameters were applied' (no mqpar.xml deposited).
The MaxQuant search enzyme was Trypsin/P; the wet-lab enzyme (Worthington trypsin) is annotated.
